paper.title: Set-based design: a review and new directions

evidence.paraphrase: The review concerns set-based concurrent engineering and lean product development in industrial design contexts.
Its discussion of literature coverage and contribution diversity does not evaluate retrieval rankings, result sets, or query or seed perturbations.

reviews.rationale: The contribution is a review of product-development design methodology, not a scholarly search, recommendation, or evidence-selection evaluation. Coverage and diversity are used descriptively in an unrelated domain, so the assigned evidence role is a semantic mismatch.

paper.title: Sustainability in Software Engineering: A Systematic Literature Review for Building up a Knowledge Base

evidence.paraphrase: The study conducts a systematic literature search in five databases and assesses the first 100 relevance-ranked results from each.
It classifies 500 retrieved records, reports 96 relevant records, identifies false term matches, and maps topical and domain coverage.
The abstract supports literature-search coverage as a bridge, but does not directly test ranking diversity, stability, or perturbation robustness.

reviews.rationale: The paper is in scope as an empirical scholarly-search validation precedent linking relevance-ranked candidate pools, false matches, and mapped research coverage. Its fit is indirect because it does not directly evaluate diversified ranking or stability under query or seed perturbations.

paper.title: Multi-objective genetic programming strategies for topic-based search with a focus on diversity and global recall

evidence.paraphrase: The method generates multiple topic-based queries while explicitly optimizing precision, recall, diversity, and global recall.
Novel objectives based on result-set similarity and entropy are evaluated experimentally against earlier evolutionary and term-weighting strategies.

reviews.rationale: This is a direct retrieval-method and evaluation contribution for result diversity and coverage across multiple generated queries. The abstract provides sufficient evidence of both the optimization objectives and comparative evaluation relevant to the assigned role.

paper.title: When AI Meets Wall Street: A Survey on Trustworthy AI in Fintech

evidence.paraphrase: The survey organizes attacks and defenses across the lifecycle of financial AI systems.
Its robustness focus concerns adversarial security and financial harm rather than robustness of search rankings or bibliographic result sets.

reviews.rationale: The paper addresses trustworthy and adversarial AI in finance, with no scholarly retrieval, recommendation, or evidence-curation workflow. The word robustness denotes security robustness in a different domain and does not support the assigned evidence role.

paper.title: A systematic review of fuzzing based on machine learning techniques

evidence.paraphrase: The review studies machine-learning methods for software fuzz testing and vulnerability discovery.
Input seeds and code coverage refer to fuzz-test generation and program execution, not search seeds or coverage of retrieved evidence.

reviews.rationale: Although the abstract uses seed and coverage terminology, these concepts belong to software fuzzing rather than scholarly retrieval or evidence selection. It therefore falls outside the frozen boundary and mismatches the coverage-diversity-stability role.
